# Gyrate Template — Tasks & Design Notes

## Source Mapping

- **ColorLib Source**: Carousel V06 (`https://colorlib.com/wp/template/carousel-06/`)
- **Preview URL**: `https://colorlib.com/wp/template/carousel-06/`
- **Assigned App Name**: `gyrate` (`@free-react-templates/gyrate`)

## Section Breakdown & Fidelity Order

1. **Navbar (`Navbar.tsx`)**: Sticky header, logo, navigation links, mobile menu toggle.
2. **Split-Screen Carousel Hero (`Hero.tsx`)**: Interactive multi-slide carousel featuring split layout (left text + CTA, right image), prev/next controls, dot indicators.
3. **Features Section (`Features.tsx`)**: 3-column feature grid with Lucide icons, hover effects, and crisp typography.
4. **Call to Action Banner (`CtaBanner.tsx`)**: High-contrast newsletter/signup banner with input validation.
5. **Footer (`Footer.tsx`)**: Multi-column links, copyright, and mandatory Component Dock link (`https://www.componentdock.com/`).

## Design Tokens & Styling

- Primary Palette: `#ffffff`, `#fdf3f1`, `#111827`, `#e11d48`.
- Fonts: Inter sans-serif.
- Icons: `lucide-react`.
- Images: `https://picsum.photos/seed/gyrate-<n>/800/600`.
